research_question: On the reused 108 developer-labeled cases, how do LLM-only warning decisions, production LLM clarification plus existing rules, and matched post-generation rule filtering compare with strong deterministic extraction?
failure_policy: First attempt per generated answer. Single provider, temperature zero. At most three HTTP 429 transport recoveries, 4.2-second request interval; stop on daily quota. Errors remain in all-case denominators. Interrupted runs are incomplete.
inference_budget: One LLM warning call and one unchanged production extraction call per case; deterministic and rule-filter arms have no further calls
gate_ablation_scope: Same LLM warnings before/after intersection with rule eligibility from the observed production context. Extra extraction cost disclosed. Not a general clinical semantic verifier.
raw_extraction_scoring: Exact name/status sets and exact source-phrase copies; raw allergy and list-status fields are not requested by the production schema and are not scored as if requested.
